afterDefects: Flat sand surround with little depth; dark heavy net band; crowd blocks look generic
Sand and court colours are a bit muted and flat with low contrast. The net is an opaque black slab and the colourful voxel crowd is cut off at the frame edges. Otherwise readable and on theme.

Players are small in the wider shot. The background stadium model looks pasted on and slightly blurred. The net is a solid black bar and the outer edges get dark. Otherwise the warm clay mood, crowd and long shadows are strong.

The tighter camera makes the players small. The background is a blurry grey backdrop with a dim stand structure. The outer clay is very saturated and a bit heavy. The scoreboard text overlaps the net-side signage.

The net is an opaque black slab. There are odd hazy light blobs on the floor near the left and right stands, and the court colour is a little flat. The crowd and signage add detail and life.
The light pools on the side stands look slightly blown out and hazy. The net is a solid dark slab. The court surface is slightly flat.
Slightly flat and pale overall with weak shadows; background tower is greyish and a little washed out
Flat lighting with fairly low contrast; the sand and pale teal court are slightly washed. The opaque net and the floating-looking background stadium model don't fit well. Small players.
Contrast is fairly flat: the beige surround is somewhat washed out and the teal court is low-contrast. The players are small, and the background stand structure is greyish.
Background is a dark muddy olive band; players are small; green-on-green is slightly low contrast
The overall palette is somewhat dark green with limited contrast, and the background is a blurry dark backdrop. Opaque black net and small players. Otherwise good mood, shadows and court striping.
The background is a blurry, dim, out-of-focus backdrop. The players are small at this camera distance. The outer green is slightly dark.

Very dark surroundings and harsh black shadows hide part of the right stand. The net is an opaque black bar and the players are small. Still, the moon backdrop, the astronaut players and the court are clearly readable.
